title: GTM / Indraprastha native 128 design language
authority: Latest user instruction: 128x128 design language for asset generation
supersedes: Earlier 32-pixel production profile for future generated asset masters
scope: Art generation and export; runtime IDs and gameplay contracts are preserved

project.creator: SD Craft
project.currency_mark: Original geometric A-K monogram with a shared upright

canvas.vector_antialiasing: Allowed when intentional and rasterized at native output resolution
canvas.pixel_filter: Nearest for integer preview scaling; native rendering for production masters
canvas.alpha: Preserve intentional transparency; no matte fringe

shared_model_atlas.rule: Preserve material-slot identities and update all platform UV dimensions consistently

signage.brand_rule: Use the brand identified by embedded_brand in the existing sign manifest

compatibility_exports.reason: Compatibility overlay where required by the client adapter

derivative_counting: Platform exports, preview images, compatibility exports and sign tiles do not increase unique-design counts

vehicle_damage_art.visual_rule: Alter visible panel, glazing, chassis, wheel or upper-structure geometry; recolouring alone is insufficient
vehicle_damage_art.material_rule: Reuse existing material registry and shared atlas
vehicle_damage_art.variant_id_status: Proposed art IDs pending engine binding

style.direction: Original contemporary Indian coastal urban voxel and pixel art
style.lighting: Consistent directional light with stepped material highlights
avoid: Copied proprietary logos or game models

immutable_contracts: Approved bilingual labels unless a documented copy correction is made
status: Art production profile; live Java/Bedrock verification remains pending
